_note: Cruise card rules, version 2 (2 Nov 2026). Not game data: a pattern read from the card list, used for SEEN / PREDICTED badges. Every value carries a state: seen, seen_time_inferred, predicted or unknown. Source: claude/CRUISE_LADDERS_CONFIRMED_2nov.md and cruise_cards_clean_30oct.json. Version 3 (7 Nov 2026): gaps filled from the koszz Cruise Ship sheet (non-red numbers only; red ones left out) and a Hammock card. Where our number and the sheet differ, ours is kept. Version 4 (8 Nov 2026): hearts/points audit (no points value was a hearts number); unproven 90-point sizes of Copper ore and Ostrich feed removed; Bamboo rice x30 added; Cotton yarn 1h30m confirmed on cards.
time_base_points_note: KEPT UNCHANGED for the calculator code that existed before version 2 (keys are the time limit in minutes). New code should use points_ladders instead.
product_base_amounts_note: KEPT UNCHANGED for the older code. Only the later bases of products that jump. New code should use products[...].steps instead.

p1h.note: 1h cards. Step 1.0 never seen (about 103). Not a clean base x step: 123 and 134 do not both fit one base.

pyarn.note: Silk thread and Coffee beans at 1h, Cotton yarn at 1h30m.

p154.note: Cotton at 1h30m. 154 and 169 are predicted; 185, 201, 216, 231 seen. 201 is 1 above base x 1.3 (200).

how_to_use: 1. SEEN: product + amount found in cards_clean list -> use it.
2. Else look in products[id].steps: find the step with this amount, or this points value, and fill the other (state predicted if state is predicted).
3. Else MANUAL. A typed card that disagrees with a predicted step is useful: log it as a miss.
4. kind lookup = no formula, only the steps that were seen. Never invent the unknown ones.
5. Warehouse stock never counts, only product finished and ready in the buildings.
